Risikoanalyse, Exit-Strategie

listings.description:
Introduction 

Are you a recent or soon-to-be graduate in physics, engineering or a related field, keen to apply your technical appreciation of physics and engineering to guide investment and business choices in the telecommunications sector? Are you fascinated by the changing way we communicate and share information and want to shape the future? Do you have a curious mindset and the drive to uncover challenges in making telecommunications technologies and processes work at a cost and scale that makes sense?  

If so, then this could be a great role for you! 

Successful candidates can join us between May and October 2027.
There is no deadline for this role, as we recruit on a rolling basis. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

About us Foundational is building the most precise picture of Earth and orbit, using lasers fired from the ground. We call it ground truth for orbit. listings.title: AI Engineer (m/w/d)
listings.description: Deine Karriere Wir suchen erfahrene AI Engineers, die KI nicht nur demonstrieren, sondern produktiv bekommen – als Teil komplexer Business-Anwendungen, die im Alltag unserer Kunden tragen müssen. Du bist Softwareentwickler mit echter Engineering-Tiefe, idealerweise mit Full-Stack-Erfahrung, und du bewegst dich sicher in Cloud-Umgebungen wie AWS und/oder Azure. Du denkst LLMs, Agenten und datengetriebene Services von Anfang an mit – und weißt, wo sie fachlich sinnvoll sind und wo nicht. Ein Schwerpunkt liegt für uns im Agentic Engineering: Systeme, die nicht nur antworten, sondern handeln – mit Tool-Zugriff, mehrstufigen Abläufen, Zustand, Fehlerbehandlung und klar definierten Grenzen. Genau hier trennt sich der Prototyp von der Lösung, die man einem Kunden guten Gewissens übergibt. Und genau hier brauchen wir Leute, die beides können: Modelle verstehen und robuste Software bauen. Wichtig ist uns: Diese Rolle bleibt hands-on. Du baust selbst, du deployst selbst, du debuggst selbst. Bei nerdware steht nicht nur der Code im Mittelpunkt, sondern vor allem der Mensch dahinter. Die beste technische Lösung entsteht dort, wo Teamgeist, offene Kommunikation und gegenseitiges Vertrauen gelebt werden. Wenn du menschlich zu uns passt, hast du den wichtigsten Schritt bereits gemacht. Wir arbeiten in einem Feld, das sich schneller verändert als jedes andere in der Softwareentwicklung. Deshalb suchen wir Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, neugierig bleiben und Hype von Substanz unterscheiden können. Eigeninitiative, technischer Weitblick und die Freude daran, gemeinsam Lösungen zu entwickeln, sind uns genauso wichtig wie ein respektvoller und wertschätzender Umgang im Team. Deine Aufgaben Konzeption, Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung von KI-gestützten Softwarelösungen – von der ersten Idee bis in den stabilen Produktivbetrieb Agentic Engineering: Entwurf und Umsetzung agentischer Systeme – Tool- und Function-Calling, Orchestrierung mehrstufiger Workflows, Kontext- und State-M

Our capabilities fuse curated data sources, domain-specific AI, and deep human expertise to transform information overload into clear, actionable foresight. Our ambition is to become the analytical backbone that organisations rely on when geopolitical uncertainty becomes an opportunity or a strategic risk. More at extrac.ai . The Role We are looking for a Software Engineer to join ExTrac's AI team, building Co-Analyst and the analytical AI features around it. Co-Analyst is a user-facing multi-agent system that works alongside intelligence analysts to research and write reports. A planning loop decomposes an analyst's question, fans work out to sub-agents, and assembles the results into a report where every claim traces back to the chunk of source it came from. Underneath sits hybrid retrieval over a large unstructured corpus: analyst intent translated into structured filters, combined with keyword and dense vector search, across multiple languages and media types. The agent work is the centrepiece but not the whole job. In a single quarter the work spans agent orchestration, retrieval, graph analytics, and long-running streaming pipelines, alongside the services and databases underneath them. You will own well-defined features and components end to end across a Python and Go codebase, working alongside senior engineers who set technical direction, the data team who own the ingestion pipelines, and a research-focused ML team who train and evaluate the models we integrate and serve. The loop is short: product brings an idea, often recent and unproven, and our job is to spike an implementation and take it to a production feature. New features land close to weekly. The watching is the floor of this role, not the ceiling. The NOC you would be joining is not a legacy one. We are building it as an AI assisted operations environment from the ground up. The forwarding plane runs on open source routing and forwarding software, every device configuration lives in Git, and an LLM layer sits on top of the live network state. When something moves, that layer reads the telemetry, correlates it against the topology and the config history, and puts a probable cause and a candidate fix in front of the engineer on shift. The point is not to replace your judgment. It is to collapse the time between an alert firing and you knowing where to look, so mean time to repair is measured in minutes. You sit inside that system. listings.title: Senior Power Electronics Engineer
listings.description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About the Role Power electronics are the bottleneck on every next-generation UAS airframe we build: motor controllers, gate drivers, and DC-DC stages are what define flight time, payload, thermal envelope, and field reliability. We're looking for a senior IC to own the analog power chain end-to-end across our UXV platforms: from MOSFET commutation simulation through PCB layout to lab validation. You will be the technical reference on power electronics inside our Lausanne engineering hub, unblocking propulsion, airframe, and embedded teams in parallel as we scale from prototype cadence to multi-platform deployment. This is a builder role, not a research seat. You ship hardware. Responsibilities Power Stage Architecture: Lead motor-controller and DC-DC topology across fixed-wing, multicopter, and hybrid UXV platforms. Translate mission constraints into power-chain specification. MOSFET Commutation & Gate-Drive Design: Own the analog switching design: dead-time tuning, gate shaping, switching-loss vs EMI vs thermal trade-offs. Multi-fidelity Simulation: Deploy the full stack: analytical loss budgeting, transient SPICE (LTspice), system-level modelling in PLECS or Simulink. BLDC Drive Stages: Design three-phase inverters with integrated current sensing, protection, Trapezoidal and FOC-aware hardware interfaces. High-Power-Density PCBA: Lead schematic and layout in Altium or KiCad with thermal, parasitics, and EM

Advanced schematic and routing design : Design and develop electronic schematics, and perform board placement/routing to meet design specifications, managing fast signal constraints. Troubleshooting : Identify and resolve issues in electrical and electronic boards through effective troubleshooting. Testing and Validation : Conduct testing, integration, and performance validation of electronic boards to meet operational and design requirements. Candidate Requirements Educational Background : Master’s degree in Electrical Engine

listings.title: Production Engineer
listings.description:
As a Production Engineer, you will play a key role within our Test Engineering team, programming test software and documenting test procedures to scale production of our next-generation drone platforms. In this position, you will take ownership of verification and production test equipment, from defining test concepts to designing automated test solutions, jigs and needle-bed adapters that help us improve yield and reliability. You’ll collaborate closely with our software and electronics engineers and OEM partners to enhance test coverage and reduce testing time, driving efficiency across our manufacturing process.

This is a hands-on role in a fast-paced, agile environment, offering the opportunity to design creative, practical test solutions from concept through to mass production. This involves balancing the transition from our existing test setups to more scalable and complete solutions in a pragmatic and iterative way for a number of different projects.

Beyond test engineering, you’ll apply your software expertise across the broader hardware and software team by supporting the engineering validation efforts of new products. You will also visit OEMs to support new product integrations and support small scale engineering runs in person.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Research, design and build test solutions, including auto generated, 3D printed test equipment and CNC milled custom test jigs, and needle-bed adapters to enable low-volume prototyping and mid- to high-volume PCB production.
  • Plan and execute product verification, covering test case definition, execution, analysis, and comprehensive documentation, also for repair guidance.
  • Write Python code and STM32 firmware to test our embedded products from the inside (selftest) and outside (via test fixture).
  • Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams by offering technical guidance and hands-on support for testing and validatio

listings.title: Electronics Engineering Intern
listings.description:
We are looking for an enthusiastic Electronics Engineering Intern to gain hands-on experience designing, building, testing, and debugging electronic hardware. Working alongside senior engineers, you’ll contribute across the development cycle—from schematic and PCB design through prototyping, testing, debugging, and documentation.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Build, assemble, test, and debug prototype circuits and PCB assemblies.
  • Assist with schematic capture and PCB design.
  • Use lab equipment such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, power supplies, and signal generators for testing and troubleshooting.
  • Support soldering, rework, and other hands-on laboratory activities.
  • Develop and test firmware for microcontrollers and embedded systems.
  • Analyse test results and document designs, tests, and project progress.
  • Work with senior engineers to troubleshoot technical issues and improve hardware performance.
  • Follow engineering and laboratory safety procedures.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Currently pursuing a Master’s degree in Electrical/Electronics Engineering or a related field.
  • Understanding of analog and digital circuit design.
  • Familiarity with PCB design tools such as Altium, KiCad, or Eagle.
  • Hands-on experience with electronics lab equipment and basic soldering.
  • Programming experience in C, C++, Python, or similar.
  • Familiarity with STM32, ESP32, Arduino, or other microcontrollers.
  • Knowledge of communication protocols such as I²C, SPI, UART, CAN, or USB is a plus.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication, and teamwork skills.
  • Hands-on experience through university, robotics, or personal electronics projects is highly valued.
  • EU citizenship required.
